sentences.zh: 我想看看这个时刻的拍摄初稿里都有什么。

sentences.en: There was a Michael voiceover.
sentences.zh: 当时有一段迈克尔的画外音。

sentences.en: Here's what it says in the script.
sentences.zh: 剧本里是这样写的。

sentences.en: Michael sits with Angela.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔和安吉拉坐在一起。

sentences.en: He looks around the room and takes in all of the dancing couples, Jim and Pam, Phyllis
sentences.zh: 他环顾四周，将所有跳舞的情侣尽收眼底，吉姆和帕姆，菲莉丝

sentences.en: and Bob, Kelly and Andy, and Kevin and Lynn, who are furiously making out.
sentences.zh: 和鲍勃，凯利和安迪，还有凯文和琳，他们正在疯狂地亲热。

sentences.en: Michael notices Angela is tapping her foot to the music and he smiles to himself.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔注意到安吉拉正随着音乐敲打着脚，他暗自微笑。

sentences.en: And this is the voiceover that would then play.
sentences.zh: 接着本该播放这段画外音。

sentences.en: That actually made me get a little choked up.
sentences.zh: 这实际上让我有点哽咽了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Isn't that so sweet?
sentences.zh: 是不是很甜？

sentences.en: I really wish that had been in.
sentences.zh: 我真的很希望这段能剪进去。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I thought that was really sweet.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这真的很甜。

sentences.en: One other thing I want to share is that when we were filming in Cafe Disco and trying to
sentences.zh: 我还想分享的一件事是，当我们在迪斯科咖啡厅拍摄，并试图

sentences.en: figure out this moment of how Michael would see my foot swaying, my finger tapping, we shot
sentences.zh: 弄清楚迈克尔如何看到我的脚在摇晃、手指在敲击这个镜头时，我们拍了一个

sentences.en: just a quick little tag that didn't make it in.
sentences.zh: 很快的小尾声，但最后没用上。

sentences.en: And everyone has left Cafe Disco and only Angela Martin is in there cleaning.
sentences.zh: 那就是所有人离开迪斯科咖啡厅后，只有安吉拉·马丁还在里面打扫卫生。

sentences.en: And Michael walks by and she is dancing as she cleans.
sentences.zh: 然后迈克尔走过去，她一边打扫一边跳舞。

sentences.en: Why do I remember this?
sentences.zh: 为什么我记得这个？

sentences.en: We just shot it really quickly and just as an alt, just in case.
sentences.zh: 我们当时拍得很快，作为一个备选方案，以防万一。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Like you actually respond to the music when everybody's left.
sentences.zh: 就像所有人都离开后，你真的会对音乐做出反应。

sentences.en: Everyone's left.
sentences.zh: 所有人都离开了。

sentences.en: But it's still that victory.
sentences.zh: 但那种胜利感依然存在。

sentences.en: He still got you.
sentences.zh: 他还是抓到你了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But that didn't make it in.
sentences.zh: 但那段没有剪进去。

sentences.en: It's not in the shooting draft.
sentences.zh: 它不在拍摄剧本里。

sentences.en: It's not in deleted scenes.
sentences.zh: 它也不在删减片段里。

sentences.en: But that was an alt that they shot.
sentences.zh: 但那是他们拍摄的一个备选镜头。

sentences.en: I wonder if we were all like waiting in the hallway while you did that or something because
sentences.zh: 我在想，当时我们是不是都在走廊里等你做完那些，因为

sentences.en: I have such a memory of it.
sentences.zh: 我对它有这么深的印象。

sentences.en: It was really quick.
sentences.zh: 真的很短平快。

sentences.en: We just sort of grabbed it in the moment.
sentences.zh: 我们当时就是顺手捕捉了这个瞬间。

sentences.en: But of course, the actual tag that made it in, which is so great, is Kelly piercing Andy's
sentences.zh: 但当然，真正剪进正片里的那个结尾——太棒了——是凯莉在洗手间给安迪

sentences.en: ear in the restroom.
sentences.zh: 穿耳洞。

sentences.en: This really lends itself to that idea that they could be a couple.
sentences.zh: 这真的很符合他们可能会成为一对的想法。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Because this is a very cute couple-y thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一件非常可爱、像情侣会做的事。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: And Halstead said that they actually did a take where Mindy, as Kelly, fully pierces Andy's
sentences.zh: 霍尔斯特德说，他们实际上拍过一个版本：敏迪饰演的凯莉，真的把安迪的

sentences.en: ear, and it was painful and bloody and a mess, but they cut it for time.
sentences.zh: 耳洞给穿了，又痛又流血，一团糟，但为了控制时长被剪掉了。

sentences.en: Well, that's it, guys.
sentences.zh: 好了，就是这样，各位。

sentences.en: That's Cafe Disco.
sentences.zh: 这就是“咖啡迪斯科”。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it was so fun.
sentences.zh: 而且真的很有趣。

sentences.en: I loved re-watching this.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢重看这集。

sentences.en: Thank you so much to Warren Lieberstein and Halstead Sullivan, Randy Cordray, for giving
sentences.zh: 非常感谢沃伦·利伯斯坦、霍尔斯特德·沙利文、兰迪·科德雷，

sentences.en: us all kinds of fun behind-the-scenes details.
sentences.zh: 为我们提供了各种有趣的幕后细节。

sentences.en: And lady, before we go, you know how at the beginning of the episodes, we always say, like,
sentences.zh: 还有，亲爱的，在我们结束之前，你知道在每集开头，我们总是会说，比如，

sentences.en: when do you listen?
sentences.zh: 你们什么时候听？

sentences.en: Where do you listen?
sentences.zh: 你们在哪里听？

sentences.en: You always say good morning.
sentences.zh: 你总是说早安。

sentences.en: And then you remember that people might not listen in the morning.
sentences.zh: 然后你又想起来，大家可能不一定在早上听。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, we got a letter from Katie C., who is 14 years old, lives in the UK.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们收到了一封来自凯蒂·C的信，她14岁，住在英国。

sentences.en: And she said, I listen to Office Ladies whilst delivering newspapers every day, and it makes
sentences.zh: 她说，我每天在送报纸的时候听《办公室女士》，这让

sentences.en: it so much more fun when it's raining or way too warm for my ginger jeans.
sentences.zh: 下雨天或者天气热得不适合穿红色牛仔裤时变得有趣多了。

sentences.en: I know I have the podcast to keep me going, and I never give up.
sentences.zh: 我知道我有这个播客陪着我，我永远不会放弃。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢这个了。

sentences.en: Well, hi, Katie.
sentences.zh: 那么，嗨，凯蒂。

sentences.en: Hi, Katie.
sentences.zh: 嗨，凯蒂。

sentences.en: Good luck today on your paper route.
sentences.zh: 祝你今天的送报路线一切顺利。

sentences.en: Be safe.
sentences.zh: 注意安全。

sentences.en: And Jenna and I are sending you big hugs.
sentences.zh: 我和珍娜给你一个大大的拥抱。

sentences.en: Thanks for listening to Office Ladies.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听《办公室女士》。

sentences.zh: 感谢收听《办公室女士：第二杯》。
